extras: Desktop-only plugin. Not affiliated with Obsidian, OpenAI, or Codex. Uses local data storage in _cortex/.
intentEvidence: Cortex Chat is an unofficial desktop-only Obsidian plugin that adds an AI chat sidebar with vault context
problem: Users need an integrated AI assistant within Obsidian that can understand and reference the content of their vault and notes.
summary: AI chat sidebar that integrates with the vault context, allowing users to chat with an assistant while referencing notes, PDFs, and memory.
